news.title: At the opening of the U-23 World Cup.. The UAE mini-football team faces England
news.lede: Zagreb, Croatia – The UAE U-23 mini-football team will open its matches against its English counterpart, on Tuesday, in the World Championship scheduled in Croatia during the period from October 11 to 17. The national team delegation, consisting of 14 players in addition to the technical and administrative staff, left on Sunday morning for the Croatian island of Mali Lusin via Dubai International Airport. In preparation for the scheduled matches, after gradual stages of preparations. The tournament matches will be held in a single group system, and each team will play 4 matches so that the teams from first to fourth qualify for the semi-finals.

news.title: Nigeria football tops agenda as FIFA Council meets
news.lede: October 12, 2026 Austine Agbo Emmanuel Sports 0. Nigeria’s deepening football crisis will come under scrutiny at Thursday’s meeting of the FIFA Council, as the world football governing body considers the leadership vacuum at the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF), the suspended electoral process and proposals for comprehensive reforms of the country’s football administration. The meeting, scheduled for October 15, 2026 comes after months of mounting dissatisfaction with the management of Nigerian football, the failure of the country’s senior men’s and women’s teams to qualify for their respective World Cups, the resignation of the NFF leadership and disagreements over how to restructure the federation.

news.title: Messi’s retirement: Nigerian legend proposes FIFA Over-40 World Cup
news.lede: October 12, 2026 Austine Agbo Emmanuel Sports 0. A former spokesman of the Federal Capital Territory Administration (FCTA), Nosike Ogbuenyi, has urged the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) to introduce an Over-40 World Cup to give retired international footballers another opportunity to showcase their skills on the global stage. Ogbuenyi said the proposed competition, designed for players aged between 40 and 65, would enable football fans to continue enjoying the talents of some of the game’s most celebrated stars long after their international careers have ended. He made the proposal after submitting it to FIFA through the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) secretariat in Abuja, arguing that the tournament could provide a new platform for former internationals, promote fitness and help keep football legends connected to the game.

news.title: FIFA Identifies 240,000 Abusive Posts During 2026 World Cup, With Racism Accounting for One in Five Cases
news.lede: More than half of the players, coaches and officials monitored by FIFA’s online protection service were targeted by abuse, while hundreds of social media accounts were referred to law enforcement over potentially threatening content. Online abuse remained a widespread problem throughout the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with more than 240,000 social media posts and comments identified as abusive during the tournament in Canada, Mexico and the United States. According to figures released by FIFA ahead of World Mental Health Day on October 10, its Social Media Protection Service (SMPS) analysed more than 17.1 million posts and comments associated with the competition, which ran from June 11 to July 19. Of those, approximately 477,000 were referred for human review, with 240,000 subsequently verified as abusive.

news.title: African sporting talents shaping world football, says Infantino
news.lede: …As CAF aim to make football self-sustaining across 54 Member Associations. FIFA president, Gianni Infantino, has reiterated the growing influence of African football, saying African talent was already shaping world football and needed better pathways to flourish globally. The FIFA President also stressed the need to keep investing in opportunity and infrastructure, and praised the scale of Africa’s improvement at the 2026 World Cup. He highlighted the contrast between recent World Cups, noting that no African team progressed from the group stage in 2018, compared with nine out of 10 in 2026.
